# tenzir_user (Data Source)

A user, looked up by email address, such as to add them to an organization with `tenzir_organization_member`. Fails unless exactly one active user has the address.

Needs `Root.listUsers`, which only platform administrators hold.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenzir_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address, in any letter case.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The user ID.
- `name` (String) The name, if known.
